verdict.rationale: Linear's integrations directory documents native first-party integrations for GitHub (PR workflow automation, issue sync, code review) and Slack (create issues from messages, sync threads, notifications), plus many other common tools such as Figma, GitLab, Datadog, Notion and Salesforce. None of the evidence mentions a Google Drive integration, so one of the three named tools is unevidenced. Missing for 10: any documented native Google Drive integration, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Slack and GitHub integrations.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Connect GitHub to automate PR workflows, review code in Linear, sync issues and understand your codebase with Linear Agent
Create issues from Slack messages and sync threads
Added ability to subscribe to events in project views and receive notifications in Inbox or Slack
Create and link issues directly from Figma
